title: MergedText
description: Schema for merged text from multiple documents belonging to a single patient, preserving per-document provenance for downstream chunking.

schema_version.description: The version of this merged text schema.

patient_id.description: UUID of the patient whose documents were merged.

merge_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the merge was performed.

source_documents.description: List of source document IDs that were merged, in merge order.

merged_segments.description: Array of merged text segments preserving per-document provenance.

document_id.description: Source document identifier for this segment.

document_location.description: Positional metadata from the source document.

page.description: Page number (1-indexed) in the source document.

segment_index.description: Zero-based index in the merged sequence.

is_document_boundary.description: True if this segment marks the start of a new document in the merged stream.
